model: Suzuki Jimny Sierra JB74 (3-door, 1.5L) — Taiwan market
notes: Suzuki Taiwan (taiwansuzuki.com.tw, 金鈴汽車) has NEVER published a paint code for any Jimny colour. Every 'code' in this file is mapped from the Japanese-market (JDM) equivalent by matching the official Taiwanese swatch/photo colour against Suzuki Japan's own colour chips. Codes are therefore INFERRED for TW, and marked with codeConfidence.
The Taiwan car site is taiwansuzuki.com.tw. suzukimotor.com.tw is Taiwan Suzuki MOTORCYCLES (台鈴機車) and does not sell the Jimny — do not use it as a source.
Taiwan sells ONE trim: JIMNY GLX, 3-door, 1.5L, 4AT, NT$849,000 (2026). The 5-door Jimny Nomade has never been imported — the 2026 TW spec sheet still lists a 2,250mm wheelbase and 3,650mm length.

TW equipment (headlamp washers, DSBS II, ACC, 9-inch screen) and the fact that TW offers all three black-roof two-tones — which in Japan are JC-grade-only — indicate the TW GLX is built to JDM JC specification.

Taiwan colour count over time: 6 colours 2019-08 to 2021-12 → 4 colours in 2022 → 5 colours 2023-01 to 2024-05 → 8 colours from 2025-04 to now. Several colours were dropped and later reinstated; see each entry's tw.years.

hex = the best-evidenced measured value. renderHex = a suggested daylight albedo for a 3D configurator (basecoat only; let the renderer's clearcoat/metallic/flake parameters do the rest). renderHex values are judgement calls, not measurements.

Suzuki Japan's own web colour chips (irodama_<CODE>.svg) are official but are stylised for two colours: the Chiffon Ivory chip (#f1e4af) is far too yellow and the Medium Gray chip (#94989a) is far too light, versus both the paint database and Suzuki Taiwan's own photography. Those two chips were rejected as the primary hex.
For two-tone cars the roof is Bluish Black Pearl (ZJ3). Suzuki publishes the combination as a single code (DG5 / 2BW / CZW) rather than two separate codes.

colors.nameJa: ピュアホワイトパール（別案: スペリアホワイト）
colors.hexSource: Suzuki Japan official chip — note Suzuki uses the SAME chip (#f0f2f2) for both 26U and ZVR, so the chip cannot distinguish them
colors.codeConfidence: LOW — UNRESOLVED. This is the one code in the TW palette I could not pin down.
colors.note: In Japan, 26U Superior White is a JL/XG-grade solid white and ZVR Pure White Pearl is the JC-grade pearl. Taiwan's GLX carries JC-grade equipment (headlamp washers) and all three JC-only black-roof two-tones, which points to ZVR. Against that: Taiwan markets it as plain 白色 with no 珍珠白 wording and draws it as a flat white swatch. No Taiwanese source states either code. Treat as pure white for rendering — the two paints differ mainly in pearl flake, not in hue.

colors.hexSource: verified — the Suzuki Japan official chip and the paint-database card agree EXACTLY at #353a2e; the TW official photo body panel #383e34 corroborates
colors.note: The two source families disagree by about one stop: Suzuki Japan and the paint card say #353a2e, Suzuki Taiwan's own swatches say #455236 (lighter and greener). The shaded panel in TW's own photo sits with the darker pair, so #353a2e is the paint and #455236 is a print/web lift. renderHex splits them for a daylight albedo.
